title: Trust should be observable.
intro: See the serving model, response times, and whether incoming field data is changing.
metricsMissing: Live metrics require the optional /model-info endpoint.
sessionOnly: This browser session only. Up to 30 successful predictions; not fleet-wide telemetry.
noObservations: Generate a recommendation to start collecting session observations.
driftBody: The KS test compares recent inputs with training reference data. Changes can signal that the model needs review.
rule: Feature drift: p < 0.01 and KS ≥ 0.15. Overall alert: at least 2 drifted features. A review badge means p < 0.01 with a smaller effect. At least 100 samples are needed; the window holds 500.
